name: VOILE RING
description: A sculptural double-petal ring in hammered gold with a delicate pearl detail. Hand-finished by Parisian artisans.

name: NOEUD RING
description: Stacked organic segments rise into a bold bamboo-inspired silhouette. A quiet statement for the wrist.

name: ECLAT RING
description: An open multi-band ring with branching gold forms, each set with brilliant-cut white crystals.

name: NUAGE RING
description: A constellation of matte gold spheres clustered into a sculptural ring. Tactile and otherworldly.

name: AUBE EARRINGS
description: Oversized crescent hoops in white enamel edged with hammered gold. Architectural and deeply refined.

name: DIEU EARRINGS
description: Surrealist mismatched earrings - one bears an eye and sun charm, the other a classical coin medallion.

name: PLEUR EARRINGS
description: A dramatic eye motif with cascading crystal chains. Equal parts mystical and maximalist.

name: GRACE EARRINGS
description: A sculptural gold hand suspends a delicate cross of bezel-set crystals. Worn as a single statement piece.

name: EDEN NECKLACE
description: A circle collar suspending an engraved teardrop pendant scattered with butterfly motifs. Quietly mythological.

name: PLUIE NECKLACE
description: Cascading gold discs and baroque pearl drops fall from a hammered circle collar. Rain frozen in gold.

name: MYTHE NECKLACE
description: A surrealist pendant - an eye, an abstract keyhole form, and a small figure suspended from a textured collar.

name: OMBRE NECKLACE
description: An abstract face rendered in gold - eye, nose and lips sculpted into a wearable work of art.

name: MASQUE CUFF
description: A hammered gold cuff bearing a sculpted face with an enamel eye and diamond nose ring. Unmistakably AUREL.

name: AME CUFF
description: An open gold cuff tracing the outline of a face - eye socket, nose and lips rendered in fine wire.

name: REGARD CUFF
description: A fluid gold cuff centred on a vivid blue enamel eye. Protective, powerful, precise.

name: DESIR BRACELET
description: A textured gold chain bracelet with a sculpted lip charm and pave diamond ring detail. Sensual and refined.
